language_probes.protocol: StandardScaler plus fixed-C L2 logistic regression; train endpoints only
StandardScaler plus fixed-C L2 logistic regression; train endpoints only

protocol.direction_selection: decoder column and sign maximizing absolute cosine with the cfc_train mean English-to-French activation difference
protocol.intervention: French activation + strength × calibrated English-to-French vector
protocol.language_retention: train-only fixed-C L2 logistic regression probe
protocol.off_axis_drift: intervention component orthogonal to the cfc_train supervised mean English-to-French activation difference, normalized by mean held-out French activation norm
protocol.random_control: isotropic Gaussian direction independently matched to each learned calibrated-vector norm
protocol.scale: train least-squares scalar projected onto the selected decoder column
protocol.semantic_geometry_proxy: correlation and mean absolute change of within-French pairwise cosine geometry
protocol.semantic_pair_proxy: rank of the paired English activation among all held-out English activations under cosine similarity
